blocks.text: Buying a Home in Fairfield Island, Chilliwack: Local Market & Neighbourhood Guide

parts.t: Fairfield Island

is a key residential search area in the eastern Fraser Valley connected via Young Road North, Menzies Road, Hope River Road, Clare Avenue, Bell Road, and Ballam Road north of Chilliwack Proper. Buyers comparing active MLS® listings in Fairfield Island will find detached single-family houses on generous 7,000 to 10,000+ sq ft flat lots (many with detached workshops or RV parking), ranchers, custom river-side homes, and ALR acreages on the northern and eastern perimeter. For a full breakdown of official community plans, catchment maps, and hazard overlays, read our
Fairfield Island Neighbourhood Guide

blocks.text: Schools, Parks & Commuting in Fairfield Island

parts.t: Families looking at homes for sale in Fairfield Island are served by Strathcona Elementary (K–5 at 46375 Strathcona Road), Little Mountain Elementary, A.D. Rundle Middle School, and Chilliwack Secondary School in SD33. Outdoor recreation and community amenities nearby include Fairfield Island Park (sports fields, baseball diamonds, tennis/pickleball courts, skate park, playground, and walking loop), Island 22 Regional Park (boat launch, off-leash dog park, bike park, and equestrian trails), and Fraser River dike trails. For commuters and transit riders, the area is served by BC Transit Route 53 Fairfield (looping along Menzies Road, Clare Avenue, and Strathcona Road into Downtown Chilliwack seven days a week).

blocks.text: Zoning, Land Use Plans & Buyer Due Diligence in Fairfield Island

parts.t: Land use and building permits in Fairfield Island are regulated by the Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan, Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) regulations on northern rural parcels, and the City of Chilliwack Floodplain Regulation Bylaw (Fraser River dike and flood construction levels). Before removing subjects on a property in Fairfield Island, verify the title search (checking for statutory building schemes, easements, geotechnical or floodplain covenants, and freehold vs. leasehold tenure) and estimate your closing taxes with our
BC Property Transfer Tax Calculator
and
First-Time Buyer Calculator

What types of homes are for sale in Fairfield Island?

Active MLS® listings in Fairfield Island typically include detached single-family houses on generous 7,000 to 10,000+ sq ft flat lots (many with detached workshops or RV parking), ranchers, custom river-side homes, and ALR acreages on the northern and eastern perimeter. All listings at the top of this page update directly from the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board MLS® feed.
Which schools serve Fairfield Island in Chilliwack School District 33?

Schools serving or located near Fairfield Island include Strathcona Elementary (K–5 at 46375 Strathcona Road), Little Mountain Elementary, A.D. Rundle Middle School, and Chilliwack Secondary School in SD33. Because SD33 catchment boundaries go by street address, always verify a specific property using the official SD33 School Locator before removing subjects.
What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near Fairfield Island?

Residents of Fairfield Island have access to Fairfield Island Park (sports fields, baseball diamonds, tennis/pickleball courts, skate park, playground, and walking loop), Island 22 Regional Park (boat launch, off-leash dog park, bike park, and equestrian trails), and Fraser River dike trails. See our
Fairfield Island Neighbourhood Guide
for detailed park addresses and trail notes.
How are roads, highway access, and public transit in Fairfield Island?

Key road corridors serving Fairfield Island include Young Road North, Menzies Road, Hope River Road, Clare Avenue, Bell Road, and Ballam Road north of Chilliwack Proper. Public transit connections include BC Transit Route 53 Fairfield (looping along Menzies Road, Clare Avenue, and Strathcona Road into Downtown Chilliwack seven days a week).
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or hazard rules apply in Fairfield Island?

Properties in Fairfield Island are governed by the Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan, Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) regulations on northern rural parcels, and the City of Chilliwack Floodplain Regulation Bylaw (Fraser River dike and flood construction levels). Before writing an offer, check the parcel's exact zoning, Development Permit Area overlays, and floodplain elevation requirements.
Are homes in Fairfield Island freehold or leasehold?

Most residential properties in Fairfield Island are freehold (fee simple) or freehold strata, though select developments in the broader Chilliwack and Cultus Lake region sit on prepaid leasehold land. Always check the Title Type field on each MLS® listing and review the title search with your Realtor and lawyer.
